one_sentence_story: By timing hungry cats escaping homemade slatted wooden puzzle boxes in 1898, Edward Thorndike overturned Victorian animal folklore and formulated the Law of Effect — showing that immediate rewarding outcomes gradually 'stamp in' successful actions without requiring conscious mechanical insight.
so_what_for_you: When building a new skill, team workflow, or habit, stop waiting for a sudden motivational 'aha!' — shrink the delay between the right action and a tangible satisfying win so trial-and-success stamps the pathway in.
